# COREY

> Local-first IFC review app for loading IFC files, inspecting model data, and
> validating elements against clause-based rules.

## LLM References

- [Validation rules contract](/llms-validation-rules.md): concise rules for generating COREY validation config JSON.
- [Validation config JSON Schema](/schemas/validation-config-v3.schema.json): machine-readable schema for exported/imported rule config.
- [User documentation](/docs/clauses): plain-language explanation of clauses and checks.
- [Clause data model](/docs/clause-data-model): developer-facing rule model and API notes.

## Notes

Generate validation configs as JSON with root `version: 3` and `clauses`.
Do not generate legacy root `rules` files.
